VIT1 family transporter (Pfam:VIT1). Originally auto-flagged as Fe³⁺ FP because located in a VIT1/FecCD/TonB iron-uptake-style locus with no LanM on the contig (per 2026-04-08_hyphomicrobium-lanm-mystery-protein.md). HOWEVER: per Jacob 2026-05-09 PM, the +33 ΔΔE may instead reflect a real Ln³⁺ transporter — VIT1 family is functionally promiscuous and a Ln-co-opted VIT1 is plausible. Keep this entry as a HYPOTHESIZED FP / candidate-Ln-transporter, not a confirmed FP. Worth following up.

Rubrerythrin / bacterioferritin family — diiron (Fe-Fe) site, not Ln. Discriminator pulls CN=8 with 4 Glu (GLU15/44/108/135) but only GLU44 (2.37+2.66) and GLU135 (2.48+2.54) are truly bidentate first-shell; GLU15 and GLU108 sit at 3.2-3.5 Å, i.e. the second Fe pocket of the binuclear site. La cramming into a binuclear Fe-Fe pocket gives 2 short + 2 long Glu, ΔΔE = +10.4 kcal/mol. Same FP class as VIT1 / Zn-site: 'high-charge cation pocket with 2 bridging Glu' that diiron, di-Mn, and Ln³⁺ all match geometrically — biology context (Pfam:Rubrerythrin / Bacterioferritin) is needed to filter out.
